name: Holiday Chilled Jumbo Boiled Shrimp Ring (No Lemon / Mild Dip Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Holiday Home Cooking & Costco Deli (Thanksgiving & Christmas)
whyItWorks: Poached jumbo tail-on shrimp is nearly 100% pure, lean protein with 0g fat and 0g fiber—making it the safest appetizer on any holiday buffet table as long as you skip the lemon wedges and fiery horseradish cocktail sauce.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the chilled poached shrimp plain, with a tiny dab of mild ketchup/mayo rose sauce, or melted butter—do NOT squeeze the included lemon wedges and skip the pungent horseradish cocktail sauce.
watchOuts: Discard the included lemon wedges (citrus trigger) and avoid heavy horseradish-chili cocktail sauce
